# Kick

> Kick is a telemedicine platform offering prescription propranolol for performance anxiety and evidence-based insomnia treatment from board-certified sleep and psychology experts.

Kick Health provides online doctor consultations and prescription delivery for two primary conditions: performance anxiety managed with beta-blockers (propranolol) and insomnia treated through cognitive behavioral therapy and medication trials. The platform connects patients with sleep medicine specialists and performance psychology leaders from top institutions.
